title: USGS Earthquake Event Record
description: Schema for USGS Earthquake Hazards Program seismic event data sourced from earthquake.usgs.gov GeoJSON feeds

event_id.description: Unique UUID for this pipeline record

usgs_id.description: USGS authoritative event identifier, e.g. us7000xxxx

time.description: UTC date-time of the earthquake origin

depth_km.description: Depth of the earthquake hypocenter in kilometers below the surface

mag_type.description: Method or algorithm used to calculate the preferred magnitude

place.description: Textual description of the event location, e.g. '10km SSE of Ridgecrest, CA'

status.description: Review status of the event record

tsunami.description: True if a tsunami advisory or warning was issued for this event

significance.description: USGS significance score (0-1000) reflecting combined impact of magnitude, felt reports, and estimated losses

felt.description: Number of Did You Feel It (DYFI) responses submitted for this event

cdi.description: Community Decimal Intensity derived from DYFI responses

mmi.description: Maximum estimated Modified Mercalli Intensity from ShakeMap

alert.description: PAGER alert level indicating estimated fatalities and economic losses

net.description: Contributing seismic network code, e.g. us, ci, nc, ak

nst.description: Number of seismic stations used to determine the hypocenter

gap.description: Largest azimuthal gap between azimuthally adjacent stations in degrees

rms.description: Root mean square of travel-time residuals in seconds

url.description: Link to the USGS event detail page

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded into the pipeline

_ingested_at.description: Timestamp when the record was ingested into the lakehouse

_source.description: Source system or API identifier for this record

_batch_id.description: Batch job identifier that produced this record
